questions.question: What is the tool's one file called, and where in github.com/lovaizu/playground does it sit? The decision gives the download address as raw.githubusercontent.com/lovaizu/playground/main/<path> but leaves <path> open, and neither the CCS nor docs/ux.md names the file. Without it the README's curl line cannot be written, so a newcomer cannot install the tool from the README alone; the later task that builds the tool must then put the file at the same place.
questions.recommended: A file named tidy-downloads, with no extension, at the root of the repository, fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lovaizu/playground/main/tidy-downloads, since this branch already makes the root README the tool's README and a file named as the command is copied onto the PATH as it is, with no renaming step.
